jobs.title: Spécialiste Crédits 80-100%
jobs.description:
Êtes-vous passionné par les prêts bancaires ? Vous êtes autonome, fiable et possédez une grande conscience professionnelle ? Vous appréciez travailler dans un environnement dynamique et stimulant où les objectifs vous motivent ? Si vous avez répondu oui à ces questions, alors rejoignez notre équipe Credit Services et faites partie d'une entreprise où votre talent sera reconnu et valorisé.

En tant que spécialiste crédits, vous serez chargé de :

• traiter les demandes de prêt approuvées à l'échelle nationale, en jouant un rôle clé dans la réalisation des projets de nos clients
• préparer les contrats de crédit avec les documents de sûreté appropriés, assurant ainsi la documentation nécessaire à nos prêts
• saisir et gérer les crédits et garanties (p.ex. les cédules hypothécaires, polices et cautions)
• emettre les promesses de paiement et leur exécution
• assurer la correspondance et le dialogue avec les registres fonciers, notaires, banques et compagnies d’assurance, établissant des relations de confiance avec nos partenaires
• maintenir des contacts professionnels avec les conseillers à la clientèle, les Credit Officers et les services juridiques

jobs.description:
UBS Securities LLC is seeking an Associate Director, Global Markets Quantitative Analyst in New York, NY
Are you an innovative thinker? Do you enjoy delivering enhanced change capabilities across a range of business functions? Are you passionate about IT process automation using cutting edge tooling platforms?

We’re looking for an Associate Director, Global Markets Quantitative Analyst to:
• Develop and maintain sophisticated decision-making system at scale. Develop and support large scale real-time trading risk monitoring system to support multi-asset risk management within global markets.
• Build out scenario analytical platform to support risk management of portfolios and client margin management. Build scalable solutions to identify opportunities for prime brokerage, Delta 1 trading, inventory management, funding, lending and collateral optimization.
• Engage and understand balance sheet and risk requirements and/or controls. Lead technology design discussions for scalability and performance.
• Can work hybrid (In-office/remote).

Qualified Applicants apply through SH-ProfRecruitingcc@ubs.com. Please reference 001520. NO CALLS PLEASE. EOE/M/F/D/V

Salary Range & Work Schedule: $170,000 to $225,000 /year, 40 hrs/wk. This notice is being posted in connection with an application for permanent Alien Labor Certification. Any person may comment or provide documentary evidence bearing on this application to: U.S. Department of Labor, Employment and Training Administration, Office of Foreign Labor Certification, 200 Constitution Avenue NW, Room N-5311, Washington, DC 20210.

The expected salary range(s) for this role as of the date of this posting is/are based on factors including, but not limited to, experience, qualifications, education, location and skill level. This role may also be eligible for discretionary incentive compensation. For benefits information, please visit ubs.com/usbenefits.

jobs.title: Spezialist/in Hypotheken und Grundbuchwesen 80 – 100%
jobs.description:
Hast du Erfahrungen in der Hypothekarverarbeitung und dem Schweizerischen Grundbuchwesen?
Ist effizientes, exaktes und verantwortungsbewusstes Arbeiten genau deine Stärke?
Hast du Freude an administrativen Tätigkeiten mit flexiblen Arbeitszeiten?

Dann bewirb dich, denn wir wollen wachsen und suchen Verstärkung!

Deine Aufgaben:
• Selbständige Abwicklung der bewilligten Kreditgesuche
• Erstellen von allen notwendigen Kredit- und Sicherungsdokumenten
• Abbilden und Bewirtschaften von Hypotheken und Sicherheiten (z.B. Grundpfänder, Policen, Bürgschaften)
• Erstellen von Zahlungsversprechen sowie fristgerechter Ausführung von Zahlungen
• Sicherstellung aller Bedingungen für die Freigabe der Hypotheken und Zahlungen
• Begleitung und korrekte Terminierung der Geschäftsfälle in Eigenverantwortung
• Korrespondenz mit Grundbuchämtern, Notaren, Banken und Versicherungsgesellschaften
• Pflichtbewusster Umgang mit potenziellen Risiken

jobs.title: Investment Banking Analyst - Leverage Finance
jobs.description:
Are you a strong analytical and inventive thinker? Do you enjoy developing pitch ideas for stakeholders, clients and investors?

We’re looking for an Investment Banking Analyst to:

• develop pitch book presentations to explain industry trends, discuss client options and recommend strategies to meet client goals
• generate new ideas and creative approaches that push the business forward
• identify and meet client needs, coordinating and working alongside colleagues and investors
• create and analyze financial models for financing transactions
• assess and analyze credit risk as the 1st line of defense
• prepare materials and present recommendations to credit committee
• assist in syndicating underwritten financing to investors, which requires deep understanding of credit risk
• manage and support the development of junior investment bankers

jobs.description:

• develop and maintain trustworthy client partnerships with the main focus on strategic advice
• implement a quantitative prospect development plan with measurable actions
• define advisory processes and agreements that best meet our clients’ needs, in cooperation with the Investment Advisor
• provide high-quality investment options for clients, working closely with team members and specialists from other areas
• grow local market network by referrals and by identifying new prospects
• make sure clients are managed in a manner that contributes to an effective risk culture on the team

jobs.description:
Are you passionate about building scalable investment capabilities and platforms that serve the most sophisticated clients? Do you thrive in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment where you can drive strategic initiatives from concept to execution? Are you a detail-oriented leader who can manage complexity while keeping the client experience at the center?

As a Product Manager in the Wealth Management Portfolio Strategy & Multi-Asset Solutions team, you will support the US House View Discretionary Models business through a blend of analytical, client-facing, and reporting work. You will have the opportunity to engage with capital markets, asset allocation, and content creation in a portfolio management environment. Your clear communication skills and attention to detail will be critical in this role.

• Product Manager and key stakeholder- serve as primary point of contact for questions and inquiries related to the Multi asset retail business. This role may include fielding inquiries from internal and external partners and resolving them appropriately. Support relationships with the various US retail advisor sales channels.
• Presentation materials - point person for maintenance and development of client presentations (pitch books, factsheets, investment reviews, etc.) and marketing materials. This role will have a focus on the maintenance of House View Portfolio Fact Sheets, the performance track record, and SharePoint site for all supporting materials. You will be expected to create and update content (presentation slides, commentary, etc.) that incorporates timely market events and help better position the Models with internal and external stakeholders. You will be partnering with portfolio managers and other product managers to develop and revise materials as appropriate.
• Represent the team in internal strategic initiatives, new product launches and projects. Translate strategic goals into actionable plans, manage key milestones, and deliver executive-level updates.
• Model portfolio subject matter expert- draft portfolio commentary and other Models’ communications, analyze model portfolios (returns, risk, performance attribution, etc.), business-related analysis and other ad hoc requests.
• Collaborate with Relationship Managers, Portfolio Advisory, and Product Specialists to ensure the House View platform meets client and advisor needs.
• Competitive Analysis - gather and analyze the competitive advantages of our industry peers and their competitive products.
• Automation - identify inefficiencies and manual processes that could benefit from automation using AI tools and leveraging internal partners to help drive strategic initiatives and grow the business.
• Manage technology-related workstreams, including vendor coordination, testing, and implementation of House View specific enhancements.

descriptionByLocale.it: Ti appassiona costruire capacità e piattaforme di investimento scalabili al servizio dei clienti più sofisticati? Cresci in un ambiente interfunzionale e frenetico in cui puoi guidare iniziative strategiche dall'ideazione all'esecuzione? Sei un leader attento ai dettagli in grado di gestire la complessità mantenendo al centro l'esperienza del cliente? In qualità di Product Manager nel team Wealth Management Portfolio Strategy & Multi-Asset Solutions, supporterai il business US House View Discretionary Models attraverso una combinazione di lavoro analitico, rivolto al cliente e di reporting. Avrai l'opportunità di interagire con i mercati dei capitali, l'allocazione degli asset e la creazione di contenuti in un ambiente di gestione del portafoglio. Le tue chiare capacità di comunicazione e l'attenzione ai dettagli saranno fondamentali in questo ruolo. • Product Manager e stakeholder chiave: fungono da punto di contatto primario per domande e richieste relative all'attività di vendita al dettaglio Multi asset. Questo ruolo può includere la risposta alle richieste di partner interni ed esterni e la loro risoluzione adeguata. Supportare i rapporti con i vari canali di vendita dei consulenti al dettaglio statunitensi. • Materiali di presentazione: persona di riferimento per la manutenzione e lo sviluppo delle presentazioni dei clienti (libri di presentazione, schede informative, revisioni degli investimenti, ecc.) e materiali di marketing. Questo ruolo si concentrerà sulla manutenzione delle schede informative del portfolio House View, sul track record delle prestazioni e sul sito SharePoint per tutti i materiali di supporto. Dovrai creare e aggiornare contenuti (diapositive di presentazione, commenti, ecc.) che incorporino eventi di mercato tempestivi e aiutino a posizionare meglio i Modelli presso le parti interessate interne ed esterne. Collaborerai con gestori di portafoglio e altri gestori di prodotto per sviluppare e rivedere i materiali in modo appropriato. • Rappresentare il team nelle iniziative strategiche interne, nel lancio di nuovi prodotti e nei progetti. Traduci gli obiettivi strategici in piani attuabili, gestisci i traguardi chiave e fornisci aggiornamenti a livello esecutivo. • Esperto in materia di portafoglio modello: redige commenti sul portafoglio e altre comunicazioni dei modelli, analizza portafogli modello (rendimenti, rischio, attribuzione delle prestazioni, ecc.), analisi relative al business e altre richieste ad hoc. • Collaborare con Relationship Manager, consulenti di portafoglio e specialisti di prodotto per garantire che la piattaforma House View soddisfi le esigenze dei clienti e dei consulenti. • Analisi competitiva: raccogli e analizza i vantaggi competitivi dei nostri colleghi del settore e dei loro prodotti competitivi. • Automazione: identificare le inefficienze e i processi manuali che potrebbero trarre vantaggio dall'automazione utilizzando strumenti di intelligenza artificiale e sfruttando i partner interni per guidare iniziative strategiche e far crescere il business. • Gestire i flussi di lavoro legati alla tecnologia, compreso il coordinamento dei fornitori, i test e l'implementazione di miglioramenti specifici di House View.
descriptionByLocale.de: Interessieren Sie sich für den Aufbau skalierbarer Investitionskapazitäten und -plattformen, die auch den anspruchsvollsten Kunden dienen? Gedeihen Sie in einem schnelllebigen, funktionsübergreifenden Umfeld, in dem Sie strategische Initiativen vom Konzept bis zur Umsetzung vorantreiben können? Sind Sie eine detailorientierte Führungskraft, die Komplexität bewältigen kann und gleichzeitig das Kundenerlebnis im Mittelpunkt stellt? Als Produktmanager im Wealth Management Portfolio Strategy & Multi-Asset Solutions-Team unterstützen Sie das US House View Discretionary Models-Geschäft durch eine Mischung aus analytischer, kundenorientierter und Berichtsarbeit. Sie haben die Möglichkeit, sich in einer Portfoliomanagementumgebung mit Kapitalmärkten, Vermögensallokation und Inhaltserstellung auseinanderzusetzen. Ihre klaren Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und Ihre Liebe zum Detail werden in dieser Rolle von entscheidender Bedeutung sein. • Produktmanager und wichtiger Stakeholder – fungieren als Hauptansprechpartner für Fragen und Anliegen im Zusammenhang mit dem Multi-Asset-Einzelhandelsgeschäft. Diese Rolle kann die Bearbeitung von Anfragen interner und externer Partner und deren angemessene Lösung umfassen. Unterstützen Sie die Beziehungen zu den verschiedenen Vertriebskanälen für Einzelhandelsberater in den USA. • Präsentationsmaterialien – Ansprechpartner für die Pflege und Entwicklung von Kundenpräsentationen (Pitchbooks, Factsheets, Investitionsberichte usw.) und Marketingmaterialien. Der Schwerpunkt dieser Rolle liegt auf der Pflege der House View Portfolio-Faktenblätter, der Leistungsbilanz und der SharePoint-Site für alle unterstützenden Materialien. Von Ihnen wird erwartet, dass Sie Inhalte (Präsentationsfolien, Kommentare usw.) erstellen und aktualisieren, die aktuelle Marktereignisse berücksichtigen und dazu beitragen, die Modelle bei internen und externen Stakeholdern besser zu positionieren. Sie arbeiten mit Portfoliomanagern und anderen Produktmanagern zusammen, um gegebenenfalls Materialien zu entwickeln und zu überarbeiten. • Repräsentieren Sie das Team bei internen strategischen Initiativen, neuen Produkteinführungen und Projekten. Übersetzen Sie strategische Ziele in umsetzbare Pläne, verwalten Sie wichtige Meilensteine ​​und stellen Sie Aktualisierungen auf Führungsebene bereit. • Fachexperte für Modellportfolios – Entwurf von Portfoliokommentaren und anderen Modellkommunikationen, Analyse von Modellportfolios (Renditen, Risiko, Leistungszuordnung usw.), geschäftsbezogene Analysen und andere Ad-hoc-Anfragen. • Arbeiten Sie mit Kundenbetreuern, Portfolioberatern und Produktspezialisten zusammen, um sicherzustellen, dass die House View-Plattform die Bedürfnisse von Kunden und Beratern erfüllt. • Wettbewerbsanalyse – Sammeln und analysieren Sie die Wettbewerbsvorteile unserer Branchenkollegen und ihrer Wettbewerbsprodukte. • Automatisierung – Identifizieren Sie Ineffizienzen und manuelle Prozesse, die von der Automatisierung mithilfe von KI-Tools und der Nutzung interner Partner profitieren könnten, um strategische Initiativen voranzutreiben und das Geschäft auszubauen. • Verwalten Sie technologiebezogene Arbeitsabläufe, einschließlich Anbieterkoordination, Tests und Implementierung spezifischer Verbesserungen für House View.
descriptionByLocale.fr: Êtes-vous passionné par la création de capacités et de plateformes d'investissement évolutives qui servent les clients les plus sophistiqués ? Vous vous épanouissez dans un environnement interfonctionnel au rythme rapide où vous pouvez piloter des initiatives stratégiques de la conception à l’exécution ? Êtes-vous un leader soucieux du détail et capable de gérer la complexité tout en gardant l’expérience client au centre ? En tant que chef de produit au sein de l'équipe Stratégie de portefeuille de gestion de patrimoine et solutions multi-actifs, vous soutiendrez l'activité des modèles discrétionnaires de US House View grâce à une combinaison de travaux d'analyse, de contact client et de reporting. Vous aurez l'occasion de vous impliquer dans les marchés des capitaux, l'allocation d'actifs et la création de contenu dans un environnement de gestion de portefeuille. Vos compétences en communication claire et votre souci du détail seront essentiels dans ce rôle. • Chef de produit et partie prenante clé - servir de point de contact principal pour les questions et demandes de renseignements liées à l'activité de vente au détail multi-actifs. Ce rôle peut inclure de répondre aux demandes de renseignements des partenaires internes et externes et de les résoudre de manière appropriée. Soutenir les relations avec les différents canaux de vente des conseillers au détail aux États-Unis. • Supports de présentation - personne-ressource pour la maintenance et le développement des présentations clients (pitch books, fiches d'information, revues d'investissement, etc.) et des supports marketing. Ce rôle se concentrera sur la maintenance des fiches d'information du portefeuille House View, des antécédents de performance et du site SharePoint pour tous les documents de support. Vous devrez créer et mettre à jour du contenu (diapositives de présentation, commentaires, etc.) qui intègre les événements opportuns du marché et aidera à mieux positionner les modèles auprès des parties prenantes internes et externes. Vous travaillerez en partenariat avec des gestionnaires de portefeuille et d'autres chefs de produits pour développer et réviser les documents le cas échéant. • Représenter l'équipe dans les initiatives stratégiques internes, les lancements de nouveaux produits et les projets. Traduisez les objectifs stratégiques en plans d’action, gérez les étapes clés et fournissez des mises à jour au niveau de la direction. • Expert en la matière du portefeuille modèle : rédiger des commentaires sur le portefeuille et d'autres communications des modèles, analyser les portefeuilles modèles (rendements, risques, attribution de performance, etc.), des analyses liées à l'entreprise et d'autres demandes ponctuelles. • Collaborer avec les gestionnaires de relations, les conseillers en portefeuille et les spécialistes de produits pour garantir que la plateforme House View répond aux besoins des clients et des conseillers. • Analyse concurrentielle – rassemblez et analysez les avantages concurrentiels de nos pairs du secteur et de leurs produits compétitifs. • Automatisation : identifiez les inefficacités et les processus manuels qui pourraient bénéficier de l'automatisation à l'aide d'outils d'IA et en tirant parti des partenaires internes pour vous aider à piloter des initiatives stratégiques et à développer l'entreprise. • Gérer les flux de travail liés à la technologie, y compris la coordination des fournisseurs, les tests et la mise en œuvre des améliorations spécifiques à House View.

• present methodologies to management and regulators for approval

jobs.title: Fixed Income Quant Trader
jobs.description:
We are seeking a quantitative trader/developer with experience in building data-driven trading systems to join our fixed income algorithmic trading team within UBS Global Markets. This is a fast paced and collaborative team specialized in the development and management of best-in-class automated strategies in the fixed income space.
The role will be focused on government bonds and Interest Rate Swaps with opportunities to work on other asset class within the fixed income space.

• Sit within the Global Markets principal e-trading business and develop next generation algorithmic trading solutions.
• You will be involved in every aspect of algorithmic trading: designing, back testing, implementing trading strategies and as well tracking performance.
• Operate within a high-performing, fast paced quant development team, whose goals are directly aligned to the business
• You will employ analysis to help optimize systematic quoting and risk management strategies.

You should possess strong analytical skills and a passion for financial markets but also be experienced in object-oriented programming preferably in Java. Proven experience in a similar role is strongly preferred.

jobs.description:
Are you passionate about data? Are you looking to drive key product and regulatory initiatives across banking products such as SBL, Mortgages, Cards and Deposits? We are looking for someone like that who will analyze product, Financial Advisor and client data, support product development, drive/support revenue-generating initiatives and work very closely with product management, control and support partners.
Key competencies and responsibilities include:

• Develop data-driven business insights and analytics to drive growth within Banking
• Key contributor to strategic initiatives and part of a team that works on business growth development initiatives
• Deliver insights and segmentation by leveraging various internal and external data to grow market share of banking products and services and support strategic banking decision making
• Use product/financial SME to demonstrate through reporting and analyses how the product area drives profitability and work to develop strategies to enhance revenues
• Develop and assist in various reporting initiatives and data analytics on banking initiatives
• Take an ownership role in product data capabilities and work within the team and with partners to ensure sound data governance and development frameworks
• Analyze complex business problems and issues using data from internal and external sources to provide insight to decision-makers
• Identify and interpret trends and patterns in datasets to construct recommendations for strategic/tactical sales plans

descriptionByLocale.it: Sei appassionato di dati? Stai cercando di guidare i prodotti chiave e le iniziative regolamentari attraverso i prodotti bancari come SBL, Mortgages, Carte e Depositi? Siamo alla ricerca di qualcuno come quello che analizzerà i dati del prodotto, del consulente finanziario e dei clienti, supporterà lo sviluppo del prodotto, le iniziative di generazione di ricavi del supporto e lavorerà molto a stretto contatto con i partner di gestione, controllo e supporto del prodotto. • Sviluppare intuizioni aziendali orientate ai dati e analisi per promuovere la crescita all'interno di Banking • Contribuente chiave per iniziative strategiche e parte di un team che lavora su iniziative di sviluppo della crescita aziendale • Fornire intuizioni e segmentazione sfruttando vari dati interni ed esterni per aumentare la quota di mercato dei prodotti bancari e dei servizi e sostenere iniziative strategiche di decisione bancaria • Utilizzare le PMI di sviluppo per dimostrare attraverso la reportistica e le strategie di sviluppo dei dati Assumere un ruolo di proprietà nelle capacità dei dati di prodotto e lavorare all'interno del team e con i partner per garantire un buon governance dei dati e dei framework di sviluppo • Analizzare complessi problemi aziendali e problemi utilizzando dati provenienti da fonti interne ed esterne per fornire informazioni ai decisori • Identificare e interpretare tendenze e modelli in dataset per costruire raccomandazioni per piani di vendita strategici/tattici
descriptionByLocale.de: Sie interessieren sich für Daten? Möchten Sie wichtige Produkt- und Regulierungsinitiativen für Bankprodukte wie SBL, Hypotheken, Karten und Einlagen vorantreiben? Wir suchen jemanden wie diesen, der Produkt-, Finanzberater- und Kundendaten analysiert, die Produktentwicklung unterstützt, umsatzgenerierende Initiativen vorantreibt und sehr eng mit Produktmanagement-, Kontroll- und Supportpartnern zusammenarbeitet. Zu den wichtigsten Kompetenzen und Verantwortlichkeiten gehören: • Entwicklung von datengesteuerten Business Insights und Analysen, um das Wachstum im Banking zu fördern • Wichtige Beiträge zu strategischen Initiativen und Teil eines Teams, das an Initiativen zur Unternehmenswachstumsentwicklung arbeitet • Bereitstellung von Erkenntnissen und Segmentierung durch die Nutzung verschiedener interner und externer Daten, um den Marktanteil von Bankprodukten und -dienstleistungen zu erhöhen und die strategische Entscheidungsfindung im Bankensektor zu unterstützen • Verwenden Sie Produkt- / Finanz-KMU, um durch Reporting und Analysen zu demonstrieren, wie der Produktbereich die Rentabilität antreibt und Strategien zur Umsatzsteigerung entwickelt • Entwicklung und Unterstützung bei verschiedenen Berichtsinitiativen und Datenanalysen zu Bankinitiativen • Übernehmen Sie eine Eigenverantwortung bei den Produktdatenfunktionen und arbeiten Sie im Team und mit Partnern, um eine solide Datenverwaltung und -entwicklung zu gewährleisten. Analysieren Sie komplexe Geschäftsprobleme und Probleme mithilfe von Daten aus internen und externen Quellen, um Entscheidungsträgern Einblick zu geben • Identifizieren und interpretieren Sie Trends und Muster in Datensätzen, um Empfehlungen für strategische / taktische Verkaufspläne zu erstellen
descriptionByLocale.fr: Êtes-vous passionné par les données? Souhaitez-vous piloter des initiatives clés en matière de produits et de réglementation pour les produits bancaires tels que les SBL, les prêts hypothécaires, les cartes et les dépôts ? Nous recherchons une personne comme celle-là qui analysera les données des produits, des conseillers financiers et des clients, soutiendra le développement de produits, pilotera/soutenira les initiatives génératrices de revenus et travaillera en très étroite collaboration avec les partenaires de gestion, de contrôle et de support des produits. Les principales compétences et responsabilités comprennent : Développer des informations et des analyses commerciales basées sur les données pour stimuler la croissance au sein du secteur bancaire. Contributeur clé aux initiatives stratégiques et membre d'une équipe qui travaille sur les initiatives de développement de la croissance de l'entreprise. Fournir des informations et une segmentation en exploitant diverses données internes et externes pour accroître la part de marché des produits et services bancaires et soutenir la prise de décision bancaire stratégique. Utiliser les PME de produits/financières pour démontrer, par le biais de rapports et d'analyses, comment le domaine de produits stimule la rentabilité et travailler à développer des stratégies pour améliorer les revenus. Développer et aider à diverses initiatives de reporting et d'analyse de données sur les initiatives bancaires. • Assumer un rôle de propriétaire dans les capacités de données sur les produits et travailler au sein de l'équipe et avec des partenaires pour garantir une gouvernance des données et des cadres de développement solides. • Analyser des problèmes et des problèmes commerciaux complexes en utilisant des données provenant de sources internes et externes pour fournir un aperçu aux décideurs. • Identifier et interpréter les tendances et les modèles dans les ensembles de données pour élaborer des recommandations pour les plans de vente stratégiques/tactiques.

jobs.description:
Are you an enthusiastic technology professional, interested in state-of-the-art frameworks, tools and techniques? Are you eager to understand and fulfill our clients’ needs?
At UBS, we re-imagine the way we work, the way we connect with each other – our colleagues, clients and partners – and the way we deliver value. Being agile will make us more responsive, more adaptable, and ultimately more innovative.

• provide engineering and analytical skills
• identify opportunities to improve our processes
• mentor junior team members
• contribute widely in establishing and promoting best practices and pro-actively investigate new technologies
• be able to perform code reviews across our team and enforce Enterprise Application design and architectural standards

jobs.title: Cash Equities CRB Quant Developer
jobs.description:
• We are seeking an experienced candidate to join our Cash Equities CRB Quantitative Developer team within UBS Global Markets
• This is a fast paced and collaborative team that are responsible for the development and enhancement of the best-in-class Cash Equities platform
• The team sits within the Global Markets Principal Flow Trading stream, and has a business reporting line
• You will be operating within a high-performing, fast paced quant development team, whose goals are directly aligned to the success of the business
• You will take ownership of initiatives from initial analysis through to design, implementation and delivery
• You will proactively suggest and drive through improvements to the platform and our framework
• You will be involved in every aspect of algorithmic trading:
o Market connectivity
o Designing, implementing and back-testing hedging, risk management and execution strategies
o Designing and building analytics to assess model and platform performance
o Latency analysis and optimisation
o Enhancing the proprietary eTrading framework that is used across the department

jobs.title: Card Processing Specialist
jobs.description:
As a key member of the Cards Processing Team, you will serve as a hands-on individual contributor supporting critical card processing activities and ensuring accurate, timely, and well-controlled execution of daily operations between UBS, internal business partners, and card vendors. This role is ideal for a detail-oriented operations professional with strong accounting and reconciliation experience who can identify exceptions, research issues, and help maintain a high-quality experience for branch and business stakeholders by:

Support the end-to-end card lifecycle, including production, personalization, distribution, maintenance, and issue resolution, while helping ensure service levels are met and operational risks are identified and addressed promptly.

Perform reconciliations across multiple general ledgers and card processing accounts, researching outages, transaction breaks, and exceptions to support timely resolution and reduce financial and operational risk.

jobs.title: S/4 Hana Finance Lead
jobs.description:
"The SAP S/4HANA Finance Delivery Lead supports the delivery of core SAP S/4HANA Finance capabilities within the ampliFi program, with primary accountability across General Ledger (GL), Group Reporting (GR), consolidation, reporting, and the broader Finance & Controlling (FI/CO) landscape. The role is responsible for driving disciplined execution across functional design, business validation, testing readiness, and production transition, ensuring that finance processes, close activities, and reporting outcomes are delivered in line with UBS accounting principles, governance, and control standards.
The role partners closely with Finance, Group Reporting and Consolidation teams, Data, Integration, and Technology stakeholders and acts as a functional representative for S/4HANA Finance within the delivery. It ensures that business requirements are translated into robust, well‑controlled finance solutions aligned with the target architecture and capable of supporting stable close, consolidation, and reporting cycles.

Key Responsibilities
- Support end‑to‑end functional delivery for assigned SAP S/4HANA Finance workstreams covering General Ledger, Group Reporting, consolidation, and reporting within the ampliFi finance stack, with clear ownership of outcomes.
- Contribute to and review functional designs and configurations across FI/CO to ensure alignment with agreed solution architecture, accounting principles, and reporting requirements.
- Ensure that S/4HANA Finance solutions support accurate posting, close, consolidation, and reporting outcomes, including integration with upstream subledgers and downstream reporting consumers.
- Develop and maintain delivery plans covering functional scope, milestones, dependencies, and impacts across S/4HANA Finance integration points and reporting consumption.
- Proactively manage risks, issues, and dependencies (RAID), with a focus on financial accuracy, close stability, consolidation integrity, and regulatory expectations, escalating where required.
- Coordinate day‑to‑day delivery across Finance, Group Reporting, Data, Integration, Testing, and Deployment teams to ensure coherent end‑to‑end execution across close, consolidation, and reporting cycles.
- Ensure adherence to agreed delivery standards, accounting principles, design decisions, and change control processes across the S/4HANA Finance scope.
- Support SIT and UAT execution from a functional perspective, including validation of close and consolidation scenarios, assessment of defects based on finance impact, and support for business sign‑off.
- Assist with production readiness and cutover preparation, focusing on stability of financial close and consolidation cycles, accuracy of balances and reports, and smooth transition to business‑as‑usual operations post go‑live.
"

descriptionByLocale.it: Sei un acuto valutatore del rischio, a cui piace indagare su processi e prodotti aziendali complessi? Vuoi svolgere un ruolo chiave nel migliorare l'efficacia dei processi aziendali critici per contribuire a salvaguardare e rafforzare UBS? Cerchiamo un esperto o un revisore dei rischi per: • pianificare, eseguire e condurre audit, emettere garanzie e revisioni di valutazione del rischio secondo i nostri standard interni che sono pienamente supportati dal lavoro svolto. • evidenziare dove i controlli funzionano bene o dove UBS deve agire per gestire meglio i rischi attuali ed emergenti e segnalare adeguatamente eventuali preoccupazioni o problemi significativi. • soddisfare i nostri standard interni per la qualità, l'esecuzione e la documentazione del lavoro di assicurazione, tenendo conto delle aspettative di copertura delle persone giuridiche, ove richiesto. • collaborare in modo proattivo e con successo con colleghi all'interno e tra i team di audit. • costruire e mantenere rapporti costruttivi con i colleghi e le parti interessate a tutti i livelli, compreso il senior management. • valutare costantemente il profilo di rischio delle attività UBS IB interessate. • partecipare alle ispezioni normative e rispondere alle richieste delle autorità di regolamentazione
descriptionByLocale.de: Sind Sie ein scharfer Risikobeurteiler und haben Freude daran, komplexe Geschäftsprozesse und Produkte zu untersuchen? Möchten Sie eine Schlüsselrolle bei der Verbesserung der Effektivität geschäftskritischer Prozesse spielen, um UBS zu schützen und zu stärken? Wir suchen einen Risikoexperten oder Prüfer für: • die Planung, Durchführung und Leitung von Audits, die Erstellung von Assurance- und Risikobewertungsprüfungen gemäß unseren internen Standards, die durch die geleistete Arbeit vollständig unterstützt werden. • hervorheben, wo die Kontrollen gut funktionieren oder wo UBS handeln muss, um aktuelle und neu auftretende Risiken besser zu bewältigen, und alle wesentlichen Bedenken oder Probleme angemessen eskalieren. • unsere internen Standards für die Qualität, Ausführung und Dokumentation der Prüfungsarbeiten einhalten und dabei, sofern erforderlich, die Erwartungen der juristischen Personen an die Deckung berücksichtigen. • proaktiv und erfolgreich mit Kollegen in und zwischen Prüfungsteams zusammenarbeiten. • Aufbau und Pflege konstruktiver Beziehungen zu Kollegen und relevanten Stakeholdern auf allen Ebenen, einschließlich der Geschäftsleitung. • kontinuierlich das Risikoprofil der relevanten UBS IB-Geschäfte bewerten. • Nehmen Sie an behördlichen Inspektionen teil und beantworten Sie Anfragen von Aufsichtsbehörden
descriptionByLocale.fr: Êtes-vous un évaluateur avisé des risques et aimez-vous enquêter sur des processus et des produits commerciaux complexes ? Souhaitez-vous jouer un rôle clé dans l’amélioration de l’efficacité des processus critiques de l’entreprise afin de contribuer à sauvegarder et à renforcer l’UBS ? Nous recherchons un expert en risques ou un auditeur pour : • planifier, exécuter et diriger des audits, émettre des examens d'assurance et d'évaluation des risques conformément à nos normes internes qui sont pleinement soutenues par le travail effectué. • mettre en évidence les domaines dans lesquels les contrôles fonctionnent bien ou les domaines dans lesquels UBS doit agir pour mieux gérer les risques actuels et émergents, et faire remonter de manière appropriée toute préoccupation ou problème important. • respecter nos normes internes en matière de qualité, d'exécution et de documentation des travaux d'assurance, en tenant compte, le cas échéant, des attentes en matière de couverture des entités juridiques. • Collaborer de manière proactive et réussie avec ses pairs au sein et entre les équipes d'audit. • établir et entretenir des relations constructives avec les collègues et les parties prenantes concernées à tous les niveaux, y compris la haute direction. • évaluer en permanence le profil de risque des activités concernées d'UBS IB. • participer aux inspections réglementaires et répondre aux demandes des régulateurs

UBS Business Solutions US LLC is seeking a Director, FX Options Trader in New York, NY
Are you an innovative thinker? Do you enjoy delivering enhanced change capabilities across a range of business functions? Are you passionate about IT process automation using cutting edge tooling platforms?

We’re looking for a Director, FX Options Trader to:
• Provide market-making and risk management for all Foreign Exchange (FX) Options emerging market currency pairs to the UBS client franchise utilizing specialized knowledge of internally developed tools and systems, including Market Maker Gui, FX Cockpit, Thor, Levitas and Brokertron.
• Focus on specialized field of knowledge in FX Options emerging markets currency to maintain accurate volatility surfaces across all the currency pairs by considering client flows and interbank market trades. Manage client flow risks and inventory positions.

Engage in FX Options initiatives to increase the UBS footprint in the U.S. market with a focus on Latin America, and partner with Sales and Strategy teams within Global Markets to capitalize on FX Options opportunities within the U.S.

jobs.title: Client Account Manager APAC Switzerland
jobs.description:
Are you curious, proactive and always striving to bring positive impact to clients?

We’re looking for a WM Client Account Manager to:
• support client advisors in delivering exceptional client service and experience
• support client advisors in administrative, risk and legal and compliance related tasks and duties
• manage daily business in WM HNW/UHNW client servicing and provide high quality service
• be the point of entry for processing client orders, e.g. stock orders, foreign exchange, loans and deposits
• be the direct contact for daily banking activities and administrative work for our clients
• manage daily client transactions and carry out inquiries and troubleshooting
• perform account maintenance tasks and client-related processes; e.g. account opening and closing, suitability reviews, initial and recurring KYC and due diligence
• support client advisors when they are on business trips and assist in preparing client meetings
